plant.title: Useful plant
plant.object: One living object and its care record
plant.source: Derived detail from retained demonstration image
plant.reading: Care, use, pet access, drainage, uncertainty, and next check remain one small operating object.
plant.action: Observe before changing care. Record what changed and when to look again.
plant.authority: Household care only. No diagnosis, purchase, dispatch, or completed-care claim.

household.title: Household habitat
household.object: Lived circulation, shade, tools, pets, water, and acceptance
household.reading: The household aperture keeps the reasons the place matters visible while separating public context from private facts.
household.action: Confirm resident intent, access, timing, and ordinary use before proposing work.
household.authority: The resident controls access and acceptance. Public context grants no entry or work authority.

property.title: Property context
property.object: Imagery, terrain, structures, drainage questions, and uncertainty
property.reading: Aerial and terrain evidence frame verification questions without inventing a surveyed parcel or current site condition.
property.action: Prepare a bounded verification plan and identify the evidence still missing.
property.authority: Planning context only. No ownership, code, utility, insurance, or work determination.

street.title: Street Glide
street.object: Provider scene, corridor coverage, registration, and public-edge questions
street.reading: Street imagery is useful only with provider, capture, direction, rights, and image-specific registration intact.
street.action: Inspect the scene receipt and request authorized capture when coverage or direction is inadequate.
street.authority: No entry, traffic control, pruning, inspection, or property finding follows from imagery.

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood fabric
neighborhood.object: Shared routes, multiple frontages, public resources, and coordination
neighborhood.reading: The neighborhood aperture relates several places without assigning condition, blame, or responsibility to one household.
neighborhood.action: Separate shared obligations from household-specific questions and route each to its accountable actor.
neighborhood.authority: Coordination context only. No ranking, eligibility, enforcement, or inferred household condition.

region.title: Regional observatory
region.object: Weather, air, water, fire, terrain, alerts, and source state
region.source: Retained terrain image with modeled source field
region.reading: Regional evidence remains time-indexed and independent. It cannot be collapsed into a parcel score.
region.action: Follow named official authorities for urgent direction and route verified mitigation needs toward assistance.
region.authority: Regional coordination only. No local condition, insurance, evacuation, damage, or loss determination.

stewardship.title: Stewardship record
stewardship.object: Evidence, holds, offers, decisions, execution, acceptance, appeal, and follow-through
stewardship.source: Authored operating graph bound to retained evidence
stewardship.reading: The final aperture carries custody and handoff rather than pretending every problem resolves into a visual layer.
stewardship.action: Create the smallest bounded offer or hold, preserve refusal and appeal, and retain completion evidence.
stewardship.authority: Only named lawful actors may create external effects. The public surface remains read-only.

care.label: Care
care.reading: Living-object and household attention. No geometry is asserted where no observation exists.

shade.label: Shade
shade.reading: Public imagery, terrain, and weather frame a canopy and exposure verification question. No canopy boundary is drawn until a semantic canopy receipt exists for the exact scene.
shade.mechanism: asset-bound canopy inventory when visible; source question otherwise

water.label: Water
water.reading: Terrain, forecast, and nearby monitoring frame drainage and runoff verification questions. No flow path is drawn until a semantic drainage receipt exists for the exact scene.
water.mechanism: asset-bound visible water-conveyance inventory when supported; source question otherwise

heat.label: Heat
heat.reading: Official observation and forecast belong in a temporal field, not a property outline.

air.label: Air
air.reading: Air is primarily a provider and time state. Missing AQI stays missing.

fire.label: Fire
fire.reading: Incident and thermal context route attention and assistance. They do not become a parcel-risk polygon.

access.label: Access
access.reading: Visible sidewalk, driveway crossing, entry path, and entry-step features are separately classified for the exact scene. Occluded or unverified connections remain absent rather than being drawn.

assistance.label: Assistance
assistance.reading: Evidence becomes a bounded offer, hold, or handoff. Assistance is an operating record, not a visual contour.
assistance.mechanism: offer, hold, decision, and handoff graph

care.description: Care renders as an attention record and next-check object, not as a spatial claim.

shade.description: Shade renders exact-asset semantic canopy and crown features where a scene-specific interpretation receipt exists. Otherwise it remains a source and field-verification question with zero image geometry.

water.description: Water renders exact-asset roof collection, gutter, downspout, and curb-gutter features where a scene-specific interpretation receipt exists. Otherwise it remains a terrain and field-verification question with zero image geometry.

heat.description: Heat renders in the temporal evidence band, not as a polygon on a photograph.

air.description: Air renders as provider and time state. Missing AQI remains missing.

fire.description: Fire renders as regional source status and official-route context, not as a parcel polygon.

access.description: Access renders only a semantic feature inventory authored against the exact displayed scene. It never follows arbitrary contrast edges.

assistance.description: Assistance renders as evidence, offer, decision, execution, acceptance, appeal, and follow-through.

reference.label: REFERENCE
reference.summary: Retained source bytes and the registration attached to those exact bytes.

live.label: LIVE / PROVIDER
live.summary: A live provider scene must carry its own asset identity and registration receipt. Live contextual data may update over a retained base without inheriting local geometry.

cached.label: CACHED
cached.summary: The last retained evidence remains visible with age, consequence, and refresh path.

map.label: MAP ONLY
map.summary: Map-only operation exposes public context and provider failure custody. No image registration is borrowed from a different scene.

held.label: HELD
held.summary: No admissible media or geometry. The interface keeps the hold, known facts, unknowns, repair path, and authority boundary visible.

resident.label: Resident
resident.question: What can the household observe, accept, refuse, or do safely now?
resident.evidence: First-party observation, ordinary use, access, burden, care history, and acceptance.
resident.action: Observe the real condition, choose the smallest ordinary action within household authority, or refuse the proposal.
resident.acceptance: Record scope, timing, access, result, uncertainty, refusal, and the next check.
resident.authority: Controls household access and ordinary care. Public context grants no entry, inspection, or work authority.
resident.handoff: Send only the bounded evidence needed by the next actor and retain private fields outside the public projection.

nursery_grower.label: Nursery / Grower
nursery_grower.question: What plant, material, care, replacement, and supply evidence is actually available?
nursery_grower.evidence: Plant identity where known, container and soil context, care history, material provenance, season, availability, and uncertainty.
nursery_grower.action: Prepare a bounded care or replacement option with alternatives, cost, timing, and what still requires observation.
nursery_grower.acceptance: The household can distinguish advice, product availability, uncertainty, and optional next steps before purchase or care.
nursery_grower.authority: May provide horticultural information and an offer. May not diagnose from imagery, enter the site, dispatch work, or claim completion.
nursery_grower.handoff: Return the option to the resident or steward with species confidence, material receipt, care boundary, and next observation.

crew_steward.label: Crew / Steward
crew_steward.question: What source, scene fit, lawful access, safety control, and completion evidence are still required?
crew_steward.evidence: Source receipts, image-specific registration, field holds, access, utilities, equipment, safety, scope, and affected-actor acceptance.
crew_steward.action: Prepare a verification plan or bounded work proposal. Hold whenever access, geometry, source scope, or authority is unresolved.
crew_steward.acceptance: Scope, access, safety, execution, before-and-after evidence, refusal, and completion or hold are independently reviewable.
crew_steward.authority: May verify or perform only work that has been accepted within lawful site and program authority.
crew_steward.handoff: Return verified questions, an accepted proposal, a refusal, or a completion receipt to the resident and program operator.

planner_program.label: Planner / Program
planner_program.question: Which public source, jurisdiction, resource, assistance route, and accountable decision belong to this scale?
planner_program.evidence: Provider health, public context, jurisdiction, source time, source gaps, assistance capacity, affected actors, and program authority.
planner_program.action: Route a source repair, bounded offer, coordination request, or explicit hold without producing one punitive place score.
planner_program.acceptance: Actor, source, purpose, offer, decision, authority, refusal, appeal, execution, and follow-through remain traceable.
planner_program.authority: May coordinate only within named lawful program authority. No insurance, eligibility, enforcement, property, or resident decision follows.
planner_program.handoff: Return household matters to the lower aperture and route shared obligations to the named accountable program or jurisdiction.

successor.label: Successor
successor.question: Can the evidence, state, geometry, authority, failure, and next review be recovered without inference?
successor.evidence: Exact source and artifact identities, transforms, failure receipts, state transitions, authorities, holds, exports, and rollback donors.
successor.action: Replay the object, reject drift or missing evidence, and preserve an explicit hold instead of inventing continuity.
successor.acceptance: A cold operator reproduces the same state and knows what it proves, what it does not prove, and who controls the next transition.
successor.authority: May verify and continue the record. May not upgrade evidence, close a hold, or authorize release or external effects by inference.
successor.handoff: Return a replay receipt, drift report, or bounded successor object with every unresolved authority and source gap intact.
